ownership.quote: Airtop (fka Switchboard) provides intelligent browser automation for AI agents, enabling seamless web interaction with any site, even those requiring complex authentication processes.

stage.quote: Icon Ventures led a $25 million Series A funding round in July 2022 for the company originally known as Switchboard, which later pivoted and rebranded into the AI web-agent platform Airtop
stage.note: Company started as Switchboard (founded 2020, Sequoia-backed seed) and pivoted/rebranded to Airtop in 2023. Google AI-overview and third-party aggregators (Tracxn, PitchBook) give somewhat inconsistent Series A dates (July 2022 vs. May 2023); no primary press release or company statement found confirming exact date/amount within the research window. A separate, unverified LinkedIn mention cites a '$20 million Series A led by TQ Ventures' which could not be corroborated and is likely inaccurate/confused with another company.

total_funding_usd.basis: PitchBook aggregator figure ('Airtop has raised $43.8M'), consistent with Tracxn's ~$38.8M-$43.8M range across seed + Series A rounds
total_funding_usd.quote: Airtop has raised $43.8M. Who are Airtop's investors? Cisco Investments, Gaingels, HubSpot Ventures, Icon Ventures, and RockawayX are 5 of 17 investors

last_round.quote: Funding Details Lead Investor: Icon Ventures Round: Series A ($25 million, announced July 2022) Co-Investors: Sequoia Capital, Spark Capital, XYZ Venture Capital, and HubSpot Ventures/Cisco Investments

employees.source: Tracxn company profile (aggregator estimate), referenced via https://www.google.com/search?q=%22Airtop%22+AI+seed+funding+million

note: Airtop began as Switchboard, a collaborative cloud-browser/coworking startup founded in 2020 by Amir Ashkenazi and Daniel Shteremberg (Sequoia-backed from 2020). It pivoted in 2023 to an AI browser-automation platform for autonomous web agents and rebranded as Airtop, now based in San Jose, CA. Investor logos on airtop.ai/about confirm Sequoia Capital, Icon Ventures, Cisco, HubSpot, and Spark Capital as backers. Funding amounts/dates for the seed (~$13.8-14M, May 2022) and Series A (~$25M, reported July 2022, though some aggregators date a Series A to May 2023) come from Google AI-overview summaries of Tracxn/PitchBook/Startup Intros rather than a primary press release found in this research window; treat exact amounts/dates as estimated pending a direct company or press confirmation.
